test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 4

questions.question: The population of a village was 2,10,000. It increased by 15% in the first year and increased by 20% in the second year. Its population after two years is _______.

A and B can complete a work in 16 days and 12 days, respectively. They started doing the work together but after 3 days B had to leave, and A completed the remaining work alone. The remaining work was completed in _________ days.
A man buys a second-hand car for ₹9,11,000 and spends ₹97,000 on its repairs. What should be its selling price (in ₹) if he wants to earn a 13% profit?
A bus is moving at a speed of 98 km/h. If its speed is reduced by 49%, then the new speed of the bus (in km/h) will be:
1% of 36% of a number is what percentage of that number?
A and B working together can do a piece of work in 16 days. B alone can do the same work in 32 days. How long (in days) will A alone take to do the same work?
A bag contains 540 coins of ₹1, 50 paisa and 25 paisa. The ratio of their rupee value is 26 : 21 : 10. Find the number of 25 paisa coins.

The difference (rounded off to one decimal place) between the compound interest (when interest is compounded annually) and the simple interest, if ₹55,700 is deposited at 3% rate of interest per annum for 2 years, is:
The average price of three items of furniture is ₹5,240. If their prices are in the ratio 3 : 5 : 7, then the price (in ₹) of the costliest item is:
The average of the marks of 13 students in a class is 59. If the marks of each student are doubled, then what will be the new average?
The distance between two points on a map is 3 cm. The scale of the map is 1 : 317659. The actual distance (rounded off to two decimal places) between the two points (in km) is:
The marked price of a fan is ₹13,000. The shopkeeper gave a discount of 12% on it. Find the selling price (in ₹) of the fan.
A year ago, the population of a city was 3,54,986. In the following year, it increased by 68,504. What was the total population of the city after the increase?
If 64 : y :: y : 9, find the positive value of y.
A, B and C can do a piece of work in 8, 6 and 24 days, respectively. How long will they take to do it, working together?

Akshay sold two washing machines, each for ₹1,080, making a profit of 20% on the sale of the first and a loss of 28% on the sale of the second. What is the total cost price (in ₹) of the two washing machines?
In what duration (in years) will ₹4,200 fetch a simple interest of ₹840 at 5% per annum rate of interest?
The LCM and HCF of two numbers are 140 and 14, respectively. If one of the numbers is 28, then find the other number.
A train passes a platform 180 m long in 45 seconds, and a tree on the platform in 30 seconds. Find the speed of the train.
Four men can dig a well 70 feet deep in 18 days. How many men can dig a well 140 feet deep in 6 days?
